note: Pinned sources for `pnpm content:build`. Raw downloads go to sources/raw/ (gitignored). A checksum mismatch stops the build: re-verify the source and its license, then update the pin deliberately.

sources.name: World English Bible Catholic Edition (WEBC), USFM
sources.version: eBible.org build of 19 Nov 2026 (re-pinned 2026-11-19 with the owner’s approval: ten typo fixes, 2 Kings 5:13 (asked you to do), Ezekiel 30:16 (a full stop), Genesis 24:7 (a closing quotation mark), Isaiah 48:13 and Jeremiah 49:29 (a capital after a full stop), Joshua 17:18 (its), Leviticus 5:18 (from the flock), Tobit 1:17 (Nineveh), Wisdom 9:12 (acceptable) and the Psalm 119 heading KAPH; the rest is Strong’s tagging, which the pipeline removes. Earlier: 17 Nov re-pin, wording changed in Greek Esther: the opening dream (1:1, affection → affliction), 1:1 (from India to Ethiopia), 3:1 and 9:10 (Bugaean → Bougean), 3:13 (the fourteenth day) and 4:5 (sent him); all other text identical to the 13 Nov build. Earlier: 13 Nov re-pin for Joshua 3:14–15, Luke 13:34 and Matthew 23:37)
